title: Imaginative design
text: We visited this home as part of a three building walking tour of Gaudi buildings.  This was the first home Gaudi designed and while it is more conventional than the other buildings, we see his inspiration from nature in the design details of the building.   We also learned about Gaudi’s life and influences. We enjoyed touring this home.
author: GoAlong2

title: ⭐ A deeply personal and unforgettable experience
text:
Casa Vicens is not just a beautiful architectural site - it’s a place filled with emotion, symbolism, and life.

Of course, the house itself is stunning. The colors, textures, ceramic details, and organic forms reveal Gaudí’s early genius in an intimate and almost poetic way. It’s the kind of place that deserves to be experienced slowly.

I chose to take the visit in Catalan, which also comes with a reduced ticket price - a wonderful initiative to encourage local engagement with such an important cultural space.

I would also like to highlight the educator/guide, who made the visit feel warm,
